I never went to school, so I farm the way my father taught me. Beans do not need chemical fertilizer — they fix the soil themselves — so I will not buy any. I will put some manure that my grandchildren helped me collect from our animals, and I will plant the bean seed I saved from last year. My sons and grandchildren will do the weeding and harvesting, so we do not need to hire anyone, and we depend on the rains because I have no way to irrigate.
